mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (member_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity)
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS cart_item_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, p.brand, p.name, p.price, p.stock, p.image_url FROM cart_item c JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
